2 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Apply [Save](https://www.linkedin.com/login?emailAddress=&fromSignIn=&session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fjobs%2Fview%2Fproject-director-hospitality-at-brailsford-dunlavey-inc-4465846762&trk=public_jobs)
* [Report this job](https://www.linkedin.com/uas/login?fromSignIn=true&session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fjobs%2Fview%2Fproject-director-hospitality-at-brailsford-dunlavey-inc-4465846762&trk=public_jobs_ellipsis-menu-semaphore-sign-in-redirect&guestReportContentType=JOB&_f=guest-reporting)
Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D), which now includes Project Management Advisors (PMA), is seeking a Project Director to join our Hospitality team in San Francisco
This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA.
**The Opportunity
** An opportunity for an experienced project management leader who thrives in complex environments, enjoys building strong client relationships, and is passionate about delivering hospitality projects that create exceptional guest experiences and long-term value.
At Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D), we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and play.
B&D partners with institutions, municipalities, and organizations to deliver complex real estate and capital projects through strategic advisory and program management services across the full project lifecycle.
B&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors (PMA), bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services. Together, the combined firm offers expanded capabilities across industries and end-to-end project delivery—from early-stage strategy through design, construction, and occupancy.
Our Hospitality team supports the development, renovation, repositioning, and expansion of hotels, resorts, mixed-use destinations, and hospitality-focused developments. We work closely with owners, investors, operators, designers, and contractors to deliver projects that enhance guest experiences while achieving operational and financial objectives.
As a Project Director, you will serve as a trusted advisor to clients and lead project teams through all phases of development, planning, design, construction, and project activation. You will be responsible for managing complex hospitality projects while ensuring alignment with client goals, schedules, budgets, and quality expectations.
**How You'll Contribute
**
* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients and project stakeholders throughout the full project lifecycle
